item.title: Data Elements and Data-intelligence Empowerment
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of Information Processing & Management invites research on data elements and their role in advancing data intelligence and empowerment. The issue seeks contributions that explore how data can be organized, understood, and leveraged to enable intelligent decision-making and organizational capabilities.
